description: List the keywords tracked in the caller's KinetixSEO account, optionally for one site (tracked_site_id from list_tracked_sites). Each keyword's id is the tracked_keyword_id that get_geo_citation_status and start_content_brief take. Read-only. Free: spends no credits.

tracked_site_id.description: Optional: only list keywords of this tracked site (an id from list_tracked_sites). Leave out to list every site's keywords.

name: list_tracked_keywords
title: List tracked keywords
